name: Palmetto Furniture Co Inc
old_description: At Palmetto Furniture, our goal is to provide quality furniture at affordable prices while taking care of our customers furniture needs from selection, purchase, delivery and set up. Our low prices and excellent service is what separates us from all other furniture dealers in North and South Carolina!
about:
Palmetto Furniture Co Inc operates from Society Hill, South Carolina, serving customers across North and South Carolina. The company functions as a furniture dealer, offering a range of home furnishings through its showroom and online presence.

The retailer carries multiple brands across categories including bedroom, living room, dining room, outdoor furniture, home entertainment, home office, and home accents. Its service model covers the full purchase cycle: product selection assistance, sales, delivery, and setup for residential customers.

Primary customers are residential buyers in the Carolinas seeking furniture for various rooms. Testimonials reference purchases such as bedroom suites and porch rockers, indicating a focus on everyday home furnishing needs.

The company states that its low prices and excellent service distinguish it from other furniture dealers in the region, emphasizing affordability and customer care as core differentiators.
